The '''Raichling language'''<ref name="Ewoks sub">{{Ewoks|Malani the Warrior}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> was a [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the snail-like beings known as [[Raichling/Legends|Raichlings]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The language could also be understood and spoken by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]]. Teebo asked several Raichlings in the native language if he and his friends could ride on their backs across a sea of mud, and the Raichlings gladly accepted his request, with Teebo then translating their response for his fellow Ewoks.<ref name="Ewoks">{{Ewoks|Malani the Warrior}}</ref>
